scenes.basis: 1:1 "The first book I wrote, Theophilus" - the address to Theophilus names no scene
1:12 "Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet" - the gathering and the ascension of 1:6-9 are on Olivet
1:12 "they returned to Jerusalem"; 1:13 "they went up into the upper room, where they were staying"
